text_block_list.text:
A few weeks have passed since Tosen Jordan 
cracked her hoof—and somehow, we managed 
to get her ready in time for the Satsuki 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Plus, you helped me with my care 
and all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it hold out. Through the Satsuki 
Sho.
choice_data_list: ...Even after that, I want you to run.
...Even after that, I want you to run.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
……I know. That's why I've been taking 
extra care of my hooves lately.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: “But... for now. I want to focus on this.”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Something terrible might happen to me 
after this. My racing career might even 
end right here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I wanna become an incredible Umamusume. 
And I've already made up my mind to put 
everything I have into racing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, look who it is. Haha... good. A 
wildcard like you is just what every 
gamble needs.

(She's Nakayama Festa. From the same debut 
class as Tosen Jordan, and a total gambler 
at heart.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Because isn't it obvious? I bet that you 
wouldn't show up for this race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !? Why? I was totally planning on running!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you're training normally, 
you're bound to witness that moment.
choice_data_list:
(...She saw the exact moment her hoof 
cracked.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yet, here you two are. Now then, I wonder 
how the Goddess's dice will roll...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Dice? Oh, I'm great at sugoroku! You like 
it too? That's kinda funny.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... got it. You smell just like that 
idiot, don't you...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Who are you calling an idiot!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
She's an idiot who'd suddenly flip the 
board and serve sashimi over it. ...Well, 
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The die was cast with you in the mix. 
Public opinion was originally saying the 
Tiara's 'Oka Sho' would be the exciting 
one, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
See, it wasn't like that at all. Haha... 
This really is the "beginning."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, time to surrender myself to the 
flow. You've prepared yourself too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that? What "beginning"...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still... I guess for the other girls, that 
might really be true, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Still. I'm gonna prove I can do it...!
